title: Writing index: choose the page structure
question: A reading page for ten essays, titles, dates, and URLs unchanged. Lock one structure, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Notebook spread
options.thesis: The archive as an open notebook on the desk: introduction on the left page, table of contents on the right.
options.viewport: A flat open notebook spans the page; Writing and the intro on the left page, years and essays on the right.
options.risk: Skeuomorphic if the pages look like paper texture; the notebook must frame real web text, and later essays spill past the spread.

options.label: Index cards
options.thesis: Each essay is a card on the daylight ground, grouped under big year labels, like the field guide's card stock.
options.viewport: Title and intro across the top; 2026's four essays as cards in two columns, 2024 beginning below.
options.risk: A card grid is the default listing pattern; it must read as a reading archive, not a blog template.

options.label: A reading list with a find field
options.thesis: A big, calm table of contents with a single find field; dates on the right, years in the margin.
options.viewport: Writing at left, intro and find field at right; below, a white panel of essay rows grouped by year.
options.risk: Plainest of the three; the type scale and spacing have to carry it, and search is modest help for ten essays.
